O1.title: Inference request path: concurrency, event loop, failure semantics
O1.notes: Two ordered stages in ONE worktree. Stage A (concurrency/event loop): A1-02, A2-01, A1-M2, A1-M1, A1-01, A4-M1, A2-04, A2-13, A1-17. Stage B (backend failure semantics & streaming stop): A2-02, A2-M1, A2-M2, A2-03, A2-05, A2-11, A2-16. A1-02/A2-01/A1-M2 share one root cause (per-request state on a shared LLMPrimitives); fix it once.

O3.title: Config / registry / runtime correctness and the stack-priors parse cost
O3.notes: Fix the stack-priors re-parse at the reader (src/registry/stack_priors.py) with an mtime-keyed cache so A1-03/A3-19 consumers need no edits. A3-16 and A4-08 are the same TD-21 shim-race fix; do it once.

O4.title: REPL / tools: permission bypasses and structured-mode defects
O4.notes: A4-01 and A4-02 are security-relevant (allowlist/size-cap and role-permission bypasses): add regression tests that prove the bypass first. A4-07 changes feature defaults; establish which source is authoritative in production (registry vs dataclass) from the code before changing anything, and keep production behaviour identical unless the current behaviour is a demonstrated bug.

O5.title: Dashboard request-path cost and silent-empty panels
O5.notes: Dashboard work happens on the event loop per connected client; measure before/after for A1-04/A1-08.

O6.title: Orchestrator scripts: live bugs and operator-ruled deletions
O6.notes: A5-01 is backed by operator ruling artifacts/operator/ruling_op19_e8_chain_20260827.json (read it in epyc-root at /workspace/epyc-root). A5-M1 implements the CLAUDE.md process rule (never kill by name pattern). Deletions: prove zero live references across all three repos again at current HEAD, delete the tests that only exercise the deleted code, and record LOC removed.

O7.title: Test-suite hazards and hygiene
O7.notes: A6-01 is the priority: tests aim destructive payloads at the REAL governance wiki on the production host. Make every such test operate on a temp copy. Do not add a CI workflow in this package (pending operator decision); do make the run commands agree (A6-04 partial: Makefile/Justfile/CONTRIBUTING consistency) only if it needs no CI file.

P1.title: Autopilot main loop: behavioural safety net, then loop bugs
P1.notes: Order: (1) the safety net B1-03/B5-02/B5-08/B1-15 so the loop is tested by behaviour, not source text; (2) the bugs. B1-01 MUST follow the safety reviewer's conditions (pause-lease interaction). Do NOT decompose _run_loop_inner in this package (that is wave 2) and keep edits to autopilot.py minimal and local.

P2.title: Autopilot safety gate and autopilot_core
P2.notes: B2-03 changes which results are admitted to learning (a decision-semantics change): implement it as the audit proposes only if the code proves the current two-sided filter contradicts its own documented intent; add tests either way. Do not touch the evaluator-fingerprinted files (eval_tower.py, rubric_scoring.py, src/autopilot_core/tier_specs.py, orchestration/eval_registry.yaml).

P3.title: Autopilot actions, config applicator, controller IO, planner, journal
P3.notes: B3-01 implements the CLAUDE.md process rule (no pgrep/pkill name patterns). Keep any autopilot.py edits to the minimum call-site change; P1 owns that file.

P4.title: Autopilot satellites: one-shot scripts, dead modules, small bugs
P4.notes: Bloat package. One-shot operator ratifiers (B4-03) and the era-pinned family (B4-02) are historical records of applied operator actions: confirm via epyc-root artifacts/operator/ and handoffs that each was applied, then delete the scripts (git history keeps them) and any tests that only exercise them. Never delete files under epyc-root artifacts/operator/.

K1.title: AutoKernel live-loop bugs and red tests
K1.notes: Only the LIVE loop (serial_run -> run.main -> pool -> pipeline -> loop). Do not delete the unified/standalone stack or other dormant planes (pending operator decision). Kernel (llama.cpp) defects are NOT patched here: per the standing operator rule (2026-10-24) they are recorded as recommendations for the champion fold (a CH-xx item in epyc-root handoffs/active/autokernel-champion-aggregate.md).

K2.title: AutoKernel evaluator/execution integrity bugs (unit C4 was NOT adversarially verified)
K2.notes: The C4 findings were never verified (the verifier hit a usage limit). Verify each first-hand and skip any that does not reproduce. C4-05 and C4-06 affect keep/discard decisions and binary attestation: write a failing test that demonstrates the defect before fixing. Kernel (llama.cpp) defects go to the champion fold, never to production.
